records.source: Oh. You just moved in, right? Cool.#$e#Out of all the places you could live, you chose Pelican Town?
records.translation: Ah. Bagong lipat ka, hindi ba? Astig.#$e#Sa lahat ng lugar na maaari mong tirhan, ang Bayan ng Pelican ang pinili mo?

records.source: Oh, really? I wasn't expecting this. It looks great, though. Thank you.$h
records.translation: Ah, talaga? Hindi ko ito inaasahan. Pero mukhang maganda. Salamat.$h

records.source: Uhh... well, I appreciate the thought.
records.translation: Uhh... aba, pinahahalagahan ko ang pag-alala mo.

records.source: Don't make fun of me... but I've never been in a relationship like this before.$l^Don't make fun of me... but I've never really had a girlfriend before.$l
records.translation: Huwag mo akong pagtawanan... pero ngayon lang ako nagkaroon ng ganitong relasyon.$l^Huwag mo akong pagtawanan... pero hindi pa talaga ako nagkaroon ng kasintahang babae.$l

records.source: Hey... you look great.$l#$e#I've been thinking about you all day...$l
records.translation: Hoy... ang ganda ng hitsura mo.$l#$e#Maghapon kitang iniisip...$l

records.source: Hey... It's been a year since we started dating, remember?$h#$e#It's been the best year of my life...$l
records.translation: Hoy... Isang taon na mula nang maging magkasintahan tayo, naaalala mo?$h#$e#Ito ang pinakamagandang taon ng buhay ko...$l

records.source: Oh yeah? ... Alright, I will.#$b#Heh... maybe this festival isn't so bad.$h
records.translation: Ah, talaga? ... Sige, sasayaw ako.#$b#Heh... baka hindi naman pala ganoon kasama ang pistang ito.$h

records.source: Demetrius has been all wound up because of the wedding, it's been pretty tense around the house.
records.translation: Balisa nang husto si Demetrius dahil sa kasal; napakabigat ng tensiyon sa bahay.

records.source: My mom's freaking out, but I'm actually kind of enjoying this. I bet the frogs are going wild out there!$h#$e#I'm gonna stay here to try and keep her calm, though.
records.translation: Nataranta si Nanay, pero medyo natutuwa talaga ako rito. Siguradong nagwawala sa tuwa ang mga palaka sa labas!$h#$e#Pero mananatili ako rito upang tulungan siyang kumalma.

records.source: I was hoping this weather would come back. It makes me appreciate the summer a little more.
records.translation: Umaasa akong babalik ang panahong ito. Dahil dito ay mas napahahalagahan ko nang kaunti ang tag-init.

records.source: The show went well. I was kind of nervous beforehand, but once we went up on stage I just kinda got into the zone.
records.translation: Naging maayos ang palabas. Medyo kinabahan ako bago iyon, pero nang umakyat kami sa entablado ay nakuha ko agad ang ritmo.

records.source: Is that obsidian? This is exactly what I've been looking for... I'm gonna see if I can shape it into a dagger.$h
records.translation: Obsidiyano ba iyan? Ito mismo ang hinahanap ko... Susubukan kong hubugin ito bilang punyal.$h

records.source: Hey, thank you. I'll drink this when the sky gets dark.
records.translation: Hoy, salamat. Iinumin ko ito kapag dumilim na ang langit.

records.source: What are you trying to say... I need to work out?$s#$b#Well, I'm more of a 'nimble' guy... Maybe I'll read the first half.$h
records.translation: Ano ang ibig mong sabihin... kailangan kong mag-ehersisyo?$s#$b#Aba, mas “maliksi” akong lalaki... Baka basahin ko ang unang kalahati.$h

records.source: $c 0.8#I really love this. How did you know?$h#Mmm... once you get used to eating raw fish, it becomes really addictive.
records.translation: $c 0.8#Gustung-gusto ko talaga ito. Paano mo nalaman?$h#Mmm... kapag nasanay ka nang kumain ng hilaw na isda, talagang nakahuhumaling iyon.

records.source: $c 0.8#Whoa... This egg speaks to me... I'll put it on my desk. Thanks!$h#Hmm... I wonder, if I put this under my pillow, will it hatch? Hehe... only one way to find out.$h
records.translation: $c 0.8#Whoa... Kinakausap ako ng itlog na ito... Ilalagay ko ito sa mesa ko. Salamat!$h#Hmm... Kung ilalagay ko ito sa ilalim ng unan ko, mapipisa kaya ito? Hehe... iisa lang ang paraan upang malaman.$h

records.source: You brought me soup? That's really nice of you.$h#$b#This one brings back a lot of memories...
records.translation: Dinalhan mo ako ng sopas? Napakabait mo.$h#$b#Nagbabalik ito ng maraming alaala...

records.source: Hey, that's a frog egg! I'll see if I can get it to hatch. Thanks!$h
records.translation: Hoy, itlog ng palaka iyan! Titingnan ko kung mapapapisa ko ito. Salamat!$h

records.source: I'm glad the path to the railroad tracks is open again.#$b#I like going up there when I feel like being alone.#$e#...Which is often.
records.translation: Natutuwa akong bukas na ulit ang daan patungo sa Riles ng Tren.#$b#Gusto kong pumunta roon kapag gusto kong mapag-isa.#$e#...Na madalas mangyari.

records.source: I liked the boat ride. At one point you couldn't see any land at all..
records.translation: Nagustuhan ko ang biyahe sa bangka. May sandaling wala kang makitang kahit anong kalupaan..

records.source: I'm ready to get back home.
records.translation: Handa na akong umuwi.

records.source: The beach is nice, but I don't love the crowds.
records.translation: Maganda ang dalampasigan, pero hindi ko gusto ang maraming tao.

records.source: You think Willy would let me lug a jet ski out here?#$b#...Nah.$h
records.translation: Sa tingin mo ba ay papayagan ako ni Willy na magdala rito ng jet ski?#$b#...Nah.$h

records.source: ...Now, if I were a tropical frog, where would I hide...$h
records.translation: ...Ngayon, kung isa akong tropikal na palaka, saan ako magtatago...$h

records.source: I bet this place looks pretty cool in the rain.
records.translation: Siguradong astig ang hitsura ng lugar na ito kapag umuulan.

records.source: It's good to get away from the computer and see the real world sometimes. I forget how nice it can be.$h
records.translation: Mabuting lumayo kung minsan sa kompyuter at makita ang tunay na mundo. Nalilimutan ko kung gaano ito kaganda.$h

records.source: I usually wear black, but in this heat...
records.translation: Karaniwan akong nagsusuot ng itim, pero sa ganitong init...

records.source: Ugh... do we have to? Alright.
records.translation: Ugh... kailangan ba talaga? Sige.

records.source: No... There's someone else I want to dance with.
records.translation: Hindi... May iba akong gustong kasayaw.

records.source: Why do you keep bothering me? I'm trying to forget about you.$s
records.translation: Bakit lagi mo akong ginagambala? Sinisikap kitang kalimutan.$s

records.source: I don't want to see you for a while.$u
records.translation: Ayaw muna kitang makita.$u

records.source: ... alright...$s#$b#I guess I'll see you around, then...$s
records.translation: ... sige...$s#$b#Siguro ay magkikita rin tayo kung gayon...$s

records.source: Hey...
records.translation: Hoy...

records.source: Um... need something?
records.translation: Um... may kailangan ka?

records.source: If I just disappeared would it really matter?$s
records.translation: May saysay ba talaga kung bigla na lang akong mawala?$s

records.source: I was thinking... people are like stones skipping over the water.#$b#Eventually we're going to sink.
records.translation: Naisip ko... parang mga batong tumatalbog sa tubig ang mga tao.#$b#Sa huli ay lulubog tayong lahat.

records.source: Sam's really outgoing, so when we hang out he does most of the talking.#$b#That's fine with me!||Imagine if Sam was as reserved as I am... we'd hang out and never say a word.$h||Some people are talkers, others are listeners. I'm more of a listener.
records.translation: Napakapalakaibigan ni Sam, kaya kapag magkasama kami ay siya ang madalas magsalita.#$b#Ayos iyon sa akin!||Isipin mo kung kasingtahimik ko si Sam... magkasama kami pero wala kaming sasabihin.$h||May mga taong mahilig magsalita at may mahilig makinig. Mas mahilig akong makinig.

records.source: What am I going to do today?#$e#Probably nothing.
records.translation: Ano ang gagawin ko ngayon?#$e#Malamang ay wala.

records.source: Sam is probably my only friend in this town.#$e#Well, Abby is nice too, but...$h#$e#Umm.. never mind.
records.translation: Siguro ay si Sam lang ang kaibigan ko sa bayang ito.#$e#Aba, mabait din si Abby, pero...$h#$e#Umm.. huwag na.

records.source: Sam is probably my only friend in this town, anymore...
records.translation: Siguro ay si Sam na lang ang kaibigan ko sa bayang ito...

records.source: You and Sam are probably my only friends in this town.$s
records.translation: Siguro ay kayong dalawa ni Sam lang ang mga kaibigan ko sa bayang ito.$s

records.source: I dunno where I'd be without you... probably in a ditch somewhere.$l
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung saan ako mapapadpad kung wala ka... malamang ay nasa kung saang kanal.$l

records.source: #$1 Sebastian1#I snuck into the caves last night and got a nasty cut from a rock crab. Don't tell anyone, okay?#$e#Hi.#$e#...want something?
records.translation: #$1 Sebastian1#Palihim akong pumasok sa mga yungib kagabi at nagtamo ng malalim na sugat mula sa Alimangong-Bato. Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman, ayos?#$e#Kumusta.#$e#...may kailangan ka?

records.source: I come here for the peace and quiet.
records.translation: Pumupunta ako rito para sa kapayapaan at katahimikan.

records.source: Why does everyone like Maru so much? Sure, she's smart and friendly, but don't they realize it's all just an attention-grabbing scam?#$e#Sorry...$s
records.translation: Bakit gustung-gusto ng lahat si Maru? Oo, matalino at palakaibigan siya, pero hindi ba nila napagtatantong pakulo lang ang lahat para mapansin siya?#$e#Paumanhin...$s

records.source: Could you picture someone like me living on a farm? It seems ridiculous.$h
records.translation: Naiisip mo ba ang isang tulad kong naninirahan sa bukid? Mukhang katawa-tawa.$h

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Hey... How are things going on the farm?#$e#Same old routine, huh? Yeah, I know a thing or two about that...|Could you picture me living on a farm?#$e#It seems ridiculous, but I have been thinking about it lately.
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Hoy... Kumusta ang lagay sa bukid?#$e#Iyon at iyon pa rin ang gawain, ano? Oo, may alam din ako tungkol diyan...|Naiisip mo ba akong naninirahan sa bukid?#$e#Mukhang katawa-tawa, pero iniisip ko iyon nitong huli.

records.source: Uh... I don't really know you.
records.translation: Uh... Hindi talaga kita kilala.

records.source: *sigh*... If gas wasn't so expensive I'd ride my motorcycle to the city today.#$e#$q 15/16 Fri_old#So what do you do when you aren't working?#$r 15 0 Fri_bad#More Farming#$r 16 30 Fri_good#Comic books#$r 15 -30 Fri_bad#Shopping#$r 15 -30 Fri_bad#Sports
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Kung hindi lang napakamahal ng gasolina, sasakay ako sa motorsiklo papuntang lungsod ngayon.#$e#$q 15/16 Fri_old#Ano naman ang ginagawa mo kapag hindi ka nagtatrabaho?#$r 15 0 Fri_bad#Higit Pang Pagsasaka#$r 16 30 Fri_good#Mga komiks#$r 15 -30 Fri_bad#Pamimili#$r 15 -30 Fri_bad#Isports

records.source: $p 16#Hey, if you're bored feel free to hang out in my room...$h|You probably prefer the small-town life, huh?
records.translation: $p 16#Hoy, kung nababagot ka, maaari kang tumambay sa kuwarto ko...$h|Malamang ay mas gusto mo ang buhay sa maliit na bayan, ano?

records.source: Oh yeah? Well, did you read the new 'Cave Saga X'? I won't spoil it for you, but oh man...$h
records.translation: Ah, talaga? Aba, nabasa mo ba ang bagong “Cave Saga X”? Hindi ko sisirain ang kuwento para sa iyo, pero naku...$h

records.source: Oh yea? Hmm... Not really my thing, but everyone's different I guess.$u
records.translation: Ah, talaga? Hmm... Hindi ko talaga hilig, pero magkakaiba naman ang lahat.$u

records.source: What? I didn't hear you... I'm busy thinking about something.#$e#What do you want?
records.translation: Ano? Hindi kita narinig... Abala akong mag-isip ng isang bagay.#$e#Ano ang gusto mo?

records.source: You know, I should be doing something productive right now. I just lose focus too fast...$s#$b#Maybe I should drink more coffee?
records.translation: Alam mo, dapat ay may ginagawa akong kapaki-pakinabang ngayon. Napakabilis ko lang mawalan ng tuon...$s#$b#Baka dapat akong uminom ng mas maraming kape?

records.source: Hey. Your name is @, right?
records.translation: Hoy. @ ang pangalan mo, tama?

records.source: Having a good weekend? ...nice.
records.translation: Maganda ba ang katapusan ng linggo mo? ...ayos.

records.source: I usually stay inside, but I do go to the beach now and then.#$b#Pretty much only when it's raining, though.#$e#For some reason, staring off into the bleak horizon makes me feel... I dunno. Like it's worthwhile to keep pushing on, I guess.
records.translation: Karaniwan akong nananatili sa loob, pero pumupunta ako kung minsan sa dalampasigan.#$b#Pero halos kapag umuulan lang.#$e#Hindi ko alam kung bakit, pero kapag nakatitig ako sa mapanglaw na abot-tanaw, pakiramdam ko ay... ewan ko. Parang may dahilan pa para magpatuloy.

records.source: What's new?$h#$e#I'll be at the saloon tonight destroying Sam at pool again.$h
records.translation: Ano'ng bago?$h#$e#Pupunta ako sa saloon mamayang gabi upang talunin na naman nang husto si Sam sa bilyar.$h

records.source: I was just thinking about you...$l
records.translation: Iniisip lang kita...$l

records.source: Okay, that'll work.
records.translation: Sige, ayos iyan.

records.source: Good choice. That works well with my role.
records.translation: Magandang pasiya. Babagay iyon sa papel ko.

records.source: Not so fast! I want to know what it is.
records.translation: Huwag muna! Gusto kong malaman kung ano iyon.

records.source: Really? It was making a lot of noise!
records.translation: Talaga? Napakaingay niyon!
